notes: The minifigure (legs, torso, head, hat) on page 3 is not in the official parts list, so it is not modelled.

Many steps show only pictures. Which exact studs each plate sits on is read from small perspective drawings, so ports are left null on most stud joins. Where the picture was ambiguous I picked the most plausible parent piece.
Page 3 steps 1-4: I assumed the first grey plate is the 2x4 pin plate (b2) and that the claw plate (3640) is added on it. The rear-chassis stack is approximate.
Dark grey plates b52-b61 (and b36) are not shown in a parts box. I placed them where the drawings show grey plates around the cab, loader front and rear top; their exact parents are a best guess.

The 4 Technic pins are: b41 and b72 through the two 1x2 Technic bricks, b64 and b73 in the 2x2 pin-hole plate. Loader link b62 sits on b41 and b64, link b71 on b72 and b73. Both links are also threaded on axle b68, with bushes b69 and b74.
Technic axle connector b70 is seated on the short axle of pole reverser b67. Its pin-hole is left unconnected because the pictures do not show it receiving anything.
The four wheels attach to the four pins of the two 2x4 pin plates (b2 and b10). The two headlight sub-assemblies are placed on the two 1x3 bricks b32 and b33.
The sticker sheet is one node. It is joined to the 1x3 bricks (7630 labels) and the curved bumper bricks (hazard stripes).

The windscreen halves are joined to each other, to the body plate b28 and to the roof b77 with null ports, since the catalogue gives them only hinge ports. Cab base b42 is joined to the side studs of b30.
